**Major recent changes to the xAI Grok API (as of September 2026) include model retirements, new frontier model releases, pricing adjustments, and feature enhancements.**[[1]](https://docs.x.ai/developers/migration/may-15-retirement)

### May 15, 2026: Major Model Retirement and Consolidation
xAI retired eight older Grok model variants effective May 15, 2026, at 12:00 PM PT to focus on newer generations. The retired models were:
- grok-4-1-fast-reasoning
- grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning
- grok-4-fast-reasoning
- grok-4-fast-non-reasoning
- grok-4-0709
- grok-code-fast-1
- grok-3
- grok-imagine-image-pro

Requests to these legacy slugs now **automatically redirect** to `grok-4.3` (or `grok-build-0.1` for the code variant). The slugs continue to resolve without requiring code changes, but:
- Reasoning variants redirect with specific effort levels (e.g., low or none).
- Pricing shifts to `grok-4.3` rates: **$1.25 per 1M input tokens** and **$2.50 per 1M output tokens** (higher than many prior models).
- Redirects may break streaming, function calling, or other workloads—explicit migration to the new model is recommended for control and reliability.[[1]](https://docs.x.ai/developers/migration/may-15-retirement)

This effectively consolidated the API toward fewer flagship models. A follow-up retirement for `grok-imagine-image-quality` is scheduled for November 2, 2026, redirecting to `grok-imagine-image-2.0` (at lower cost for equivalent quality).[[2]](https://docs.x.ai/developers/migration/imagine-image-quality-nov-2)

### New Model Releases
- **Grok 4.6** (August 2026): The current frontier model optimized for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work.
  - Context window: 500k tokens.
  - Knowledge cutoff: February 1, 2026.
  - Modalities: Text + image input, text output (no output limit).
  - Reasoning effort: Low, medium, high (default), or xhigh.
  - Pricing: $2.00 / $0.50 (cached) / $6.00 per 1M tokens (short context); higher for long context (≥200k).
  - Available via Responses API, Chat Completions, and integrated in tools like Cursor, Grok Build, OpenRouter.[[3]](https://x.ai/docs/developers/grok-4-5)

- Earlier in 2026: Grok 4.5 and Grok 4.3 were released with similar capabilities (coding/agentic focus, configurable reasoning, up to 1M context in some cases). Grok 4.1 variants were among those retired in May.[[4]](https://x.ai/docs/release-notes)

- Specialized models like `grok-build-0.1` (for agentic coding, ~$1–2 per 1M tokens) and various Imagine models for image/video generation were also updated or added.[[5]](https://x.com/xai/status/2060392252858589669)

### Pricing Overview (Current as of mid-2026)
Pricing is usage-based and tiered by context length. Examples (per 1M tokens, USD):
- **grok-4.6**: $2.00 input / $0.50 cached / $6.00 output (short); doubles for long context.
- **grok-4.3 / grok-4.20 variants**: $1.25 input / $0.20–0.40 cached / $2.50 output (with long-context surcharges).
- **grok-build-0.1**: Lower at ~$1.00 input / $2.00 output.
- Batch API offers discounts (e.g., 20% on certain models). Imagine (image/video) and Voice APIs have separate per-image/second/character rates.[[6]](https://x.ai/docs/developers/pricing)

Caching, prompt caching keys, and context compaction are heavily encouraged to reduce costs, especially for long agent loops.

### Other Notable Updates
- **Tools and API enhancements**: Improved function/tool calling (parallel calls, up to 128 tools), server-side execution for web/X search, code interpreter. Responses API updates, Grok Skills for persistent custom expertise, and better integration with agentic workflows.[[7]](https://www.infoq.com/news/2026/05/xai-grok-skills/)
- **Console and features**: Public changelog, usage insights, voice cloning, image/video generation in playground, Batch API support (not all models, e.g., Grok 4.6 excluded from Batch in some cases), and mobile/console improvements.[[8]](https://x.ai/api/changelog)
- **Compatibility**: OpenAI/Anthropic SDK compatible; custom model support for third-party or self-hosted backends.[[9]](https://github.com/xai-org/grok-build/blob/main/crates/codegen/xai-grok-pager/docs/user-guide/11-custom-models.md)
- **X API integration**: X (formerly Twitter) updated its own API pricing and introduced xAI credits as incentives for heavy X API users.[[10]](https://www.socialmediatoday.com/news/x-formerly-twitter-announces-new-api-pricing-structure-xai/811667/)

For the latest details, check the official docs at [docs.x.ai](https://docs.x.ai) or the console at [console.x.ai](https://console.x.ai). Model pages include specific rate limits, benchmarks, and migration guides. Changes emphasize fewer, more capable models with better tooling for agents and developers.
